linkPost.title: LinkedIn post URL
linkPost.description: Optional. Use this when you want to crawl one specific LinkedIn post URL.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Keyword query for LinkedIn post search, for example: AI hiring, data analyst, SaaS marketing.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Optional hashtags to include in the LinkedIn post search. Use values with or without #.

maxPosts.title: Max posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to extract from search results.

fromMember.title: Filter by member IDs
fromMember.description: Optional LinkedIn member IDs to filter authors. Example: ACoAAxxxxxx.

fromCompany.title: Filter by company IDs
fromCompany.description: Optional LinkedIn company IDs to filter posts by company.

authorIndustry.title: Filter by author industry IDs
authorIndustry.description: Optional LinkedIn industry IDs to filter post authors.

linkedinCookie.title: LinkedIn cookie
linkedinCookie.description: Required. Paste either the raw li_at value or the full LinkedIn cookie string from your browser.
